I could not identify the change or the ticket. The code shows how the de-duplication was reworked, but the search budget ran out before I found the PR, commit, or ticket. The server-side proposal is only hinted at in code comments, not described in any ticket I could reach.

**How the de-duplication was reworked**

- **Same-name merge at tree load.** When the tree is initialised, tests that resolve to the same `flatName` through different roots are merged, not concatenated. Each test's obs list is copied so the cached trees are not mutated, and re-initialising gives the same result. (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-reducer.ts:129-138`)
- **Multiset-max union.** `mergeObsMultisetMax` treats obs with the same `obsDatetime|value` as one identity. For each identity it keeps the highest count seen in either list. Equal obs within one list survive; copies of a list across branches collapse. (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-reducer.ts:11-39`)
- **Documented limitation.** The comment says `obsDatetime + value` is the best identity available "until the backend exposes obs uuids". Two genuinely separate results with the same value and time that only ever appear in separate lists cannot be told apart from copies. This is the case the question describes. (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-reducer.ts:11-18`)
- **Panel-scoped identity in the viewer.** `deriveGroupKey` takes the panel name from `flatName` (index 1). `normalizedTests` then merges branches by `groupKey_conceptUuid`, so one concept under one panel collapses, while the same concept under two panels stays as two rows. Table, timeline and result counts all derive from this list. (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-context.tsx:39-47`, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-context.tsx:113-149`)

**Server side**

The obstree REST resource builds one obs list per concept-set branch, which is why copies appear. (`openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/ObsTreeResource1_9.java:128-158`) I found no ticket text proposing to expose obs uuids. The only trace is the comment above, so the proposal itself is unconfirmed.

**Tests that pin the behaviour**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-reducer.test.ts:591-640`
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/filter-context.test.tsx:442-502`

**Not found**

- The ticket key and the PR or commit that introduced this change. Searches for ticket patterns (`O3-`, `TRUNK-`, `RESTWS-`) in the tests-app and the webservices repository returned nothing, and Falkon search does not index commit messages.
- The server-side change for obs uuids. The only reference is the code comment cited above.

Next step: the ticket and change should come from the blame of `filter-reducer.ts` lines 11-18 and `filter-context.tsx` lines 113-121, or from the commit history of `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/filter/`. Neither is available through my tools here.
